scope: Native standalone OpenRouter full-callback stdin fallback for SSH/headless, without a new TUI input mode or duplicate exchange path

reference.meaning: Existing pinned source confirms manual input raced with the ephemeral listener for remote/headless CLI. We require the complete owned callback URL, not its permissive loose-code parser or callback-host override. Separate source review confirms models/user personalization is wired in coding-agent/src/core/model-runtime.ts and remains required.

implementation: auth login <label> --issuer openrouter prepares hidden standalone stdin before publishing instructions/authorization URL. Bounded8192-byte/fatal-UTF8 single-line input uses no readline/history/output, owns raw mode only when necessary and restores/pauses its input on EOF/error/retirement. EOF/empty input disables paste without cancelling browser callback; raw Ctrl-C invokes the existing command owner and abort/deadline semantics. Helper accepts a complete callback only for its already bound origin/UUID path, no userinfo/fragment/control/foreign endpoint. It forwards GET solely to that owned loopback listener, reusing its parser/one-shot admission/Core PKCE/CAS publication and publication-before-close rather than adding another key-exchange path. Shared owner clips reader/local request; callback winner cancels hidden input. Invalid paste fails closed without overwriting prior key. No opener, new flags/issuer endpoints or TUI input owner borrowing; /login still uses browser callback and remote users can first run standalone auth.
proof: Four new reader/security cases cover hidden raw setup/restoration/no history, fatal UTF8/size/EOF, caller/keyboard retirement and a foreign loopback trap receiving zero requests with prior key preserved. Existing emitted print case now uses piped full callback, JSON/RPC retain browser+EOF, and one new real node-pty case proves no private code echo through actual terminal output. All four perform fixed S256/JSON/native key publication,0600 encrypted stores/two independent C inference processes/logout, exact10-token/$0.00004 accounting per assistant and private-output guards. Raw input is ready before authorization URI is displayed, avoiding an echo race. No new account/model/profile matrix.
